definition: Five independent contexts/source/condition, 50/500 notes in normal 4/12 columns, 375/1440x900, AB/BA order. Synchronous synthetic input/click/key/pointer dispatch; two rAF proxy, save indicator followed by exact state reload. Save timing preserves 160ms debounce. Not physical input/paint/INP, real IME or touch.
